subject: RE: [LT-0017] Quotation 20ft + 40HQ Italy to Aqaba
body_text:
Dear Nour,

Thank you for your enquiry. Our offer, EX WORKS Gualtieri to Aqaba port, direct service, 1 x 20ft + 1 x 40HQ on the same vessel:

OPTION 1 - Genoa
Shipping line: Med Express Line, direct
ETD Genoa: 18 Oct 2026, transit 18 days
Ocean freight: USD 1,950 / 20ft, USD 2,900 / 40HQ
EXW pickup Gualtieri to Genoa: USD 480 / 20ft, USD 650 / 40HQ
THC origin: USD 160 / 20ft, USD 220 / 40HQ
ISPS: USD 12 / container
Total per box: USD 2,602 / 20ft, USD 3,782 / 40HQ

OPTION 2 - La Spezia
Shipping line: Med Express Line, direct
ETD La Spezia: 21 Oct 2026, transit 19 days
Ocean freight: USD 1,900 / 20ft, USD 2,850 / 40HQ
EXW pickup Gualtieri to La Spezia: USD 520 / 20ft, USD 700 / 40HQ
THC origin: USD 160 / 20ft, USD 220 / 40HQ
ISPS: USD 12 / container
Total per box: USD 2,592 / 20ft, USD 3,782 / 40HQ

Other fees, both options, per shipment: BL fee USD 60, export customs clearance USD 120.
Not included: destination charges at Aqaba, insurance.
Free time at Aqaba: 14 days demurrage and detention, then USD 40/day per container.
Rates valid until 31 Oct 2026, subject to equipment availability and space confirmation.

Best regards,
Med Express Line - Genoa office
